semantic_findings.title: Unpinned npm Package Execution With Credential Access
semantic_findings.description: The recommended command uses npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, executing a mutable registry release without installation confirmation. The package inherits the required API-key environment variable, so a compromised release could access credentials and local files.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The command explicitly selects @latest with -y, and the skill requires a runtime API credential. This establishes supply-chain exposure, not evidence of malicious package behavior.

content.user_title: Research Douyin Topics With Traceable Samples
content.value_statement: Content teams need relevant Douyin examples before choosing topics. This skill guides SocialDataX searches and trending-list retrieval, then separates evidence from proposed content angles.
actual_capabilities: Search Douyin by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or corresponding available MCP tool.
Retrieve the current Douyin trending list without a keyword and distinguish it from search results.
Filter search samples by publication period, duration, and content type, with optional chronological or like-count sorting.
Collect bounded result pages, preserve continuation tokens, and resume partial results within the original limits.
Organize returned titles, authors, links or content IDs, and available metrics separately from suggested content angles.
Distinguish image content and audio resources when interpreting returned media fields.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access and SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY; CLI use also requires Node.js, npm, and network access.
Service balance limits and API failures can interrupt retrieval; search results are not an exhaustive Douyin archive.
Does not log in to Douyin, publish content, like posts, comment, or modify accounts.
Live retrieval and field availability depend on external tools; the supplied files do not include their implementation.

use_cases.title: Plan a Creator Topic Shortlist
use_cases.description: Find relevant examples for a chosen niche and identify candidate angles while retaining source titles, authors, and links.

use_cases.title: Research Brand Content Themes
use_cases.description: Review keyword samples by time period and engagement sorting to compare observed themes without claiming complete market coverage.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Editorial Research Brief
use_cases.description: Combine a separate trending-list summary with bounded keyword samples, evidence, interpretation, and follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Find Initial Topic Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for [keyword] using one page. List relevant titles, authors, and available source links, then suggest three angles based on those samples.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect a small initial sample.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Trending Topics
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the current Douyin trending list without a keyword. Identify entries relevant to [audience], separating ranking signals from your topic suggestions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: use current trends as research signals.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Recent Content Approaches
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [keyword] for videos under one minute published this week, sorted by likes. Limit retrieval to 20 items and separate evidence from interpretation.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [keyword] using at most three pages and 40 items. Preserve source identifiers and filters. Compare observed angles and propose follow-up questions. If retrieval is partial, report gaps and resume only with a valid continuation token within the remaining limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: produce traceable research with partial-result recovery.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: research small-apartment storage ideas from one page.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results were retrieved for this example.
Evidence: list each returned title, author, source link or content ID, and available publication time.
Interpretation: explain which observed approaches address the requested audience and why.
Follow-up: inspect the strongest samples before expanding the search.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: continue research after a partial retrieval failure.
output: Status: retrieval is incomplete; retain the collected samples and report the service error.
Recovery: after resolving the error, continue with the returned nonempty cursor and unchanged search filters.
Limits: subtract completed pages and collected items from the original limits before continuing.
Boundary: do not restart from page one automatically or label partial results as exhaustive.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit item limits before expanding the sample.
Preserve source identifiers, query filters, and content types; separate observations from interpretations.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version and configure credentials outside prompts, shared files, and generated reports.
anti_patterns: Treating trending ranks or highly liked samples as proof that a proposed topic will succeed.
Requesting all search results or presenting a bounded sample as complete market coverage.
Restarting partial retrieval from page one or changing continuation tokens, causing duplicate work and avoidable service usage.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a keyword or topic direction. Add an audience, brand, time period, or content type when you need a narrower sample.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Retrieval requires shell access to the CLI or access to the corresponding MCP tools.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or service balance?
faq.answer: The documented service requires SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY. An insufficient-balance error can require funding the matching SocialDataX account before retrieval continues.

faq.question: Can this skill publish or interact with Douyin accounts?
faq.answer: No. Its documented workflow retrieves research data without logging in, publishing, liking, commenting, or modifying accounts.

faq.question: What happens if retrieval stops partway through?
faq.answer: Keep existing items and the error. Resume with a valid continuation token after resolving the failure, without exceeding the original limits.

faq.question: Are the results complete or guaranteed to predict successful topics?
faq.answer: No. Searches provide bounded samples, and trending lists provide current signals. Topic suggestions are interpretations, not guarantees of reach or engagement.
